text:
Which property does hydrochloric acid have?
A
It gives a pale blue precipitate with aqueous copper(II) sulphate.
B
It gives a white precipitate with aqueous barium nitrate.
C
It releases ammonia from aqueous ammonium sulphate.
D
It releases hydrogen with zinc powder.

options.label: A
options.text: It gives a pale blue precipitate with aqueous copper(II) sulphate.

options.label: B
options.text: It gives a white precipitate with aqueous barium nitrate.

options.label: C
options.text: It releases ammonia from aqueous ammonium sulphate.

options.label: D
options.text: It releases hydrogen with zinc powder.
